item.title: Signage needed for out of use zip wire in Chis Rec, 25th July
item.description:
Ideally we’d like this fixed by yesterday! But since there’s no sign of that, please put up a notice to explain. Just caught an adult man ripping a branch of a tree. When asked what he was doing he and his boy explained they wanted to unhook the zip wire with it. I told them this would not work and asked him politely to not teach children to rip branches off trees. That said, several playground trees could do with a little attention!
